identity.title: [v0.92][ADR] Author and review the milestone architecture decision record set

values.task_boundary: Correct the stale v0.92 ADR plan, author and index source-grounded Proposed or Deferred ADR candidates 0059 through 0071, validate numbering and evidence links, obtain exact-head independent review, and publish a documentation-only PR.
deliverables: Corrected canonical v0.92 ADR plan and accepted baseline
Thirteen uniquely numbered Proposed or Deferred ADR candidate documents
Reviewer-facing v0.92 ADR evidence and disposition index
Focused numbering, status, link, evidence, and non-claim validator
Exact-head architecture, security-boundary, and documentation review evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The accepted ADR baseline is derived from docs/adr/README.md and candidate numbers 0059 through 0071 do not collide
AC-2: Every number 0059 through 0071 has exactly one Proposed or Deferred candidate document and index row
AC-3: Every candidate contains status, context, decision, consequences, alternatives, source evidence, validation evidence, supersession relationships, non-claims, and approval boundary
AC-4: Existing ADRs are cited rather than duplicated and conflicts or supersessions are explicit
AC-5: ADR 0070 remains a non-production planning boundary proven by source consistency and copied-state negative cases, not an end-to-end production transfer claim
AC-6: ADR 0069 and ADR 0071 are drafted only if their named real executable proof is landed; otherwise they are explicitly Deferred
AC-7: Authority, security, replay, and mutation decisions cite focused positive and fail-closed negative proof when such proof has landed
AC-8: No candidate claims personhood, production citizenship, completed v0.93 governance, unrestricted adaptive learning, or production cross-polis migration
AC-9: Focused validation proves numbering uniqueness, status policy, required sections, repository-relative evidence links, index completeness, and diff hygiene
AC-10: One fresh independent exact-head review covers architecture, security boundaries, documentation truth, and all candidate dispositions with no unresolved actionable findings
dependencies: Current accepted ADR registry through ADR 0058
Landed v0.92 implementation and exact proof surfaces for each drafted candidate
Canonical v0.92 feature contracts and issue wave
Explicit human approval for any future ADR acceptance
non_goals: No reopening accepted ADRs without a documented conflict
No production cross-polis migration or transfer proof
No v0.93 citizenship or governance implementation
No synthetic proof credit for planned but unexecuted WP-18A or WP-18B work
